senses.definition: (Scotland, slang, derogatory, offensive) A person, usually a youth, of low social standing and education, a violent disposition and with a particular style of dress (typically sportswear or Burberry), speech and behaviour.
examples: The mindless behaviour of drunken neds and nuisance neighbours brings misery to tens of thousands of honest folk.

quotes.text: You could live in a place for twenty years, you could clean up its streets and lock up its neds.
